newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs end off amid heavy options trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs end off amid heavy options trade.

text.p: Brazil stocks declined in heavy trade as investors exercised options and a large player sold options in some leading shares to buy calls and puts for February, brokers said.
"Everything today was options settlements," one broker said. "No other factors really affected the market."
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index of 49 most-traded shares closed down 0.39 percent at 66,544 points on volume of 1.758 billion reais.
Brokers said options trade dominated the market, with Telebras getting much of the attention at the strike price of 76 reais.
Meanwhile, one brokerage swapped Cemig, Petrobras, Vale do Rio Doce and Paranapanema options for February calls and puts, one broker said.
Dealers said investors were keeping a watchful eye on a possible drop linked to declines on Wall Street but the market was largely unaffected by local and foreign news.
"We were expecting a big fall today but it didn't fall much," one broker said.
